title: Monologue
description: Whenever you play a card this turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
smart_description:
Whenever you play a card this turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
Currently granting [blue][accumulator][/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
notes: Monologue has a dynamic stack type: it displays as a Counter when StrengthApplied > 0 (tracking cumulative Strength granted this turn), and as None when StrengthApplied = 0. The power tracks which cards were played after it was applied and accumulates bonus Strength for each card played. At the end of the turn, it removes itself and applies a negative Strength to offset the bonuses.
